criteria.text: After a once-ready owned API exits unexpectedly, UI transitions to reconnecting and returns ready after a bounded delayed replacement becomes healthy.
criteria.test_id: C5: once-ready owned exit enters reconnecting and returns ready after one replacement

criteria.text: Repeated immediate crashes stop at documented attempt budget; Retry works afterward.
criteria.test_id: C5: repeated immediate owned exits stop at the finite recovery budget

criteria.text: Stop/dispose produces no replacement; concurrent Retry/exits spawn one child; old exit callbacks cannot clear the new child.
criteria.test_id: C5: duplicate and stale exit events cannot create concurrent replacement starts

criteria.text: Alive unhealthy and external reused processes are not killed by automatic recovery.
criteria.test_id: C5: health-only failure changes status without starting or killing a process

criteria.text: A child emitting native stderr without trailing newline then exiting leaves that text plus timestamp/PID/code in durable bounded log after it is gone.
criteria.test_id: C6: final non-newline stderr is persisted with UTC timestamp, pid, and exit code

criteria.text: Rotation remains bounded, final bytes are flushed, and log failure doesn't prevent recovery.
criteria.test_id: C6: diagnostics rotation remains bounded while preserving the newest native stderr

criteria.text: Explicit stop and dispose suppress a late owned-exit recovery.
criteria.test_id: C5: explicit stop and dispose suppress a late owned-exit recovery

criteria.text: External server reuse has no owned exit and does not trigger recovery.
criteria.test_id: C5: external server reuse has no owned exit and does not trigger recovery

criteria.text: A diagnostics write failure is non-fatal to recovery.
criteria.test_id: C6: diagnostics write failure is non-fatal to recovery
